gloss: subject of a painting; title of a painting

definitions.gloss: subject of a painting; motif; pictorial theme
definitions.explanation: The subject matter or theme depicted in a painting or drawing. Can also refer to the title given to a finished artwork.

examples.japanese: {富士山|ふじさん}は{人気|にんき}のある{画題|がだい}だ。
examples.english: Mount Fuji is a popular painting subject.

examples.japanese: {花鳥|かちょう}は{日本画|にほんが}の{代表的|だいひょうてき}な{画題|がだい}である。
examples.english: Flowers and birds are a quintessential subject in Japanese painting.

examples.japanese: コンクールの{画題|がだい}は「{私|わたし}の{故郷|ふるさと}」で、{参加者|さんかしゃ}は{自由|じゆう}に{描|えが}いてよい。
examples.english: The painting theme for the contest is 'My Hometown,' and participants may paint freely.

notes:
USAGE: {画題|がだい} is used in art criticism, exhibition descriptions, and discussions of painting. It can mean both the subject matter (what is depicted) and the title (the name of the work).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画題|がだい}を{選|えら}ぶ: to choose a subject for a painting
- {画題|がだい}にする: to use as a painting subject
- {人気|にんき}のある{画題|がだい}: a popular painting subject

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {画題|がだい}: painting subject or title
- {題材|だいざい}: subject matter (broader, not limited to painting)
- {主題|しゅだい}: main theme (of any work of art or discourse)
